output_file.description: Path to the file where runlim logs status information. If empty or not set, output goes to stderr.

time_limit.description: The time limit in seconds. Represents accumulated CPU time for multi-threaded programs. 0 means no limit.

real_time_limit.description: The real time (wall clock) limit in seconds. 0 means no limit.

space_limit.description: The space limit in megabytes. 0 means no limit.

kill_signal.description: If true, runlim propagates signals to the child process when limits are exceeded.

command.description: The command and its arguments to be executed and benchmarked by runlim.
